reasoning_content: The emulator is up and running (`emulator-5554  device`). `adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed` didn't output anything (it might still be booting up). Let's wait until it reaches `1`, then install the APK.

action.command: for i in $(seq 1 20); do bc=$(/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r'); [ "$bc" = "1" ] && break; sleep 10; done; echo "boot_completed=$bc"; /opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb install -r /workspace/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-ni-release.apk 2>&1 | tail -2
